digest.component_or_area: Jira DC adapter pagination and fetcher fail-open handlers
propositions: _paged_search lacks offset-stall detection and spins unbounded when a server ignores/repeats startAt offsets instead of advancing
fail-open exception handlers at get_parent_map and three fetch_snapshot enrichment sites swallow raised stall errors and degrade to silent empty maps rather than propagating them
guards must be added at transport boundary (_paged_search) and at four fail-open sites (get_parent_map, fetcher.py three handlers) to abort loudly instead of silently truncating
existing well-behaved servers that page correctly must continue recovering full result sets unchanged through all three whole-project readers
the stall error must live in core backend module so fetcher.py can name it without creating a layering inversion
